regimeSub: Korea chip rally ignites risk bid while US consumer exhaustion keeps Warsh sidelined through Sept.
themes: KOSPI surges 5% on Samsung/SK Hynix rally (Aug 17) → HBM/AI demand narrative reignites Korea tech bid; USDKRW grinds to 1409 as foreign inflows accelerate
July retail sales largest drop in 12 months (Aug 14) still echoing → Q3 GDP tracking sub-1.5%, Warsh Sept hold fully priced; Fed hike cycle dead on arrival
BOK Deputy Gov Yu (Aug 11) signals further hikes → August BOK decision live as KRW stability mandate overrides soft growth; rate divergence widening vs Fed
Gold $4486 catching stagflation-lite bid → Brent capped at $91 post-OPEC+ expansion but energy-driven CPI at 3.3% keeps real rates negative; safe haven rotation persists
